purpose: Rules `safe2 assess --pro` uses to turn harness configuration names into manifest flags. Heuristics, not proof: the hosted rules GR-01 to GR-08 trust these flags, so a named reviewer should sign this file before the flags are relied on.
token_matching: Tool names are split into lowercase tokens on non-alphanumeric characters and camelCase boundaries. A category matches on an exact tool name or on any token. Only tool names are examined; arguments are never read into a category decision.
approval_rule: Only a bare tool name in the permission `ask` list counts as an approval point. A rule with a specifier, such as Bash(git push:*), covers a subset of uses and is not counted.

cannot_detect.mandate_configured: No reliable configuration signal for a delegation mandate (scope, hop limit, budget). Written false for every spawning agent.
cannot_detect.memory_provenance: No reliable configuration signal that memory writes record a source. Written false for every agent with persistent memory.
cannot_detect.budget_ceiling_configured: No reliable configuration signal for a spend ceiling enforced outside the model. Written false for every agent that moves money.
